name: Spotify Likes
summary: Like, search, play and transfer Spotify music
description: Like or unlike the current Spotify song with the heart in Ledge’s players. Sign in to Spotify on the add-on’s settings page; Ledge keeps the sign-in. Enabled AI apps can search songs and play a selected result on your active Spotify device. Playback requires Premium and reconnecting Spotify for playback permission. List Spotify Connect devices and transfer playback to a chosen device. Reconnect Spotify to allow device discovery.
author: Ledge
